consider.body: specs/verifications/e04s04-build.md line 28 still says the current contiguous attempt is bg_212 and not a PASS. The status header and the later artifact://1399 table correctly record the completed local gate. A reader of only the attempt list can treat a finished local run as incomplete. Rewrite that sentence as history of 1396; do not treat it as a source defect.

Parent artifact://1399 rows were read, not re-executed: selected 7, workspace 391/30/10 ignored, default 280/12/7 ignored, Bun 8/49, showcase 1. Security findings 0 and operational findings 0 at confidence >= 0.8. This PASS is not Task 4 or whole-story acceptance.
